ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The waveform of the current drawn by a semi-converter from a sinusoidal AC voltage source is shown in the image. If \( I_0 = 20 \) A, the RMS value of the fundamental component of the current is _______ A (up to 2 decimal places).
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is ωt, and the sine wave is labeled Vm sin(ωt). The current waveform is a rectangular pulse: from 30° to 180° it is positive I0, from 180° to 210° it is zero, from 210° to 360° it is negative I0, and it repeats periodically. Therefore take α=30°, and i(θ)=I0, α≤θ≤π; i(θ)=-I0, π+α≤θ≤2π; the remaining intervals are 0. Reasoning calculation: the fundamental Fourier coefficients are a1=(2I0/π)∫α^π cosθ dθ=-(2I0/π)sinα, b1=(2I0/π)∫α^π sinθ dθ=(2I0/π)(1+cosα). The fundamental peak value I1m=sqrt(a1^2+b1^2)=(2I0/π)sqrt(sin^2α+(1+cosα)^2). The fundamental RMS value I1=I1m/√2. Substitute I0=20 A, α=30°: I1=(40/(π√2))sqrt((0.5)^2+(1+0.8660)^2)=17.39 A.

raw_record.question_text: The waveform of the current drawn by a semi-converter from a sinusoidal AC voltage source is shown in the image. If \( I_0 = 20 \) A, the RMS value of the fundamental component of the current is _______ A (up to 2 decimal places).

method.method_draft: Let θ=ωt and α=30°. From the image define i(θ)=I0 for α≤θ≤π, i(θ)=-I0 for π+α≤θ≤2π, and zero elsewhere. Compute a1=(2I0/π)∫α^π cosθ dθ=-(2I0/π)sinα and b1=(2I0/π)∫α^π sinθ dθ=(2I0/π)(1+cosα). Then the peak value of the fundamental is I1m=sqrt(a1^2+b1^2)=(2I0/π)sqrt(sin^2α+(1+cosα)^2). Convert to RMS: I1=I1m/√2. Substitute I0=20 A and α=30° to obtain about 17.39 A.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中横轴为 ωt，正弦波标注为 Vm sin(ωt)。电流波形是矩形脉冲：从 30° 到 180° 为正的 I0，从 180° 到 210° 为零，从 210° 到 360° 为负的 I0，并周期性重复。因此取 α=30°，可定义 i(θ)=I0，α≤θ≤π；i(θ)=-I0，π+α≤θ≤2π；其余区间为 0。推理计算：基波傅里叶系数为 a1=(2I0/π)∫α^π cosθ dθ=-(2I0/π)sinα，b1=(2I0/π)∫α^π sinθ dθ=(2I0/π)(1+cosα)。基波峰值 I1m=sqrt(a1^2+b1^2)=(2I0/π)sqrt(sin^2α+(1+cosα)^2)。基波 RMS 值 I1=I1m/√2。代入 I0=20 A，α=30°：I1=(40/(π√2))sqrt((0.5)^2+(1+0.8660)^2)=17.39 A。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct computation from the waveform using sine and cosine Fourier coefficients; it derives both coefficients by integration rather than invoking a pre-known converter current formula.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the plotted source-current waveform: current is zero from 0 to 30°, equals +I0 from 30° to 180°, zero from 180° to 210°, and equals -I0 from 210° to 360°, repeating with half-wave symmetry. Also read the firing angle α = 30° from the image.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text-given value I0=20 A and the requested output as the RMS value of the fundamental component in amperes.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use Fourier series for a periodic current i(θ): a1=(1/π)∫0^{2π}i(θ)cosθ dθ, b1=(1/π)∫0^{2π}i(θ)sinθ dθ, and fundamental RMS = sqrt(a1^2+b1^2)/sqrt(2). Half-wave symmetry can reduce the two nonzero intervals to twice the positive interval.

method.method_draft: From the graph take α=30° and constant pulse magnitude I0. Apply the standard semi-converter input-current fundamental formula I1,rms=(2√2/π)I0 cos(α/2). Substitute I0=20 A and α/2=15°: I1,rms=(2√2/π)(20)cos15°, then round the numerical result to two decimal places, giving 17.39 A.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中标出了正弦电源电压 Vm sin(ωt) 以及半控整流器从交流源吸取的矩形电流波形。电流脉冲幅值为 I0；正半周电流从 30° 开始持续到 180°，负半周电流从 210° 开始，对应触发角 α = 30°。推理：按指定方法，半控整流器输入电流基波的 RMS 值为 I1,rms = (2√2/π) I0 cos(α/2)。代入 I0 = 20 A，α/2 = 15°，得 I1,rms = (2√2/π) × 20 × cos15° ≈ 17.39 A。
